title: Vector and Gravity
author: Kestrel Okonkwo
blurb: Ada Zhou, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
